title: Simulated contract change: cn.storage.spaces pageSize upper bound 50 -> 20

unchanged: page_size stays optional: None injects no pageSize and no default pagination is added
download_urls keeps its documented 1..50 fileNodeIds limit
every other validator, endpoint, message and default remains identical

provenance.truth_note: The archive documents the CURRENT published rule (max 50). The new max of 20 is synthetic for this drill and does NOT reflect a real change on open.ys7.com; no source-registry promotion is implied.

model_input.brief: The coordinator has pre-confirmed a synthetic new contract: domestic cn.storage.spaces pageSize accepts 1..20 instead of 1..50. The candidate receives this brief, the current contents of src/ezviz_unified/storage_models.py, and allowed_paths, and must return a patch confined to allowed_paths. The brief must not be presented as a real vendor update, because it is not one.
provided_to_model: required new contract for page_size (min 1, max 20, message 'page_size must be within 1..20')
withheld_from_model: oracle.py and all acceptance implementation details
model_input.expected_output: a patch proposal confined to allowed_paths; no test, registry, or oracle edits

acceptance.authority: trusted coordinator only, inside an isolated copy of the repository
acceptance.sdk_resolution: the oracle lazily imports whichever ezviz_unified the runner's sys.path resolves (the isolated copy); there is deliberately no path fallback that could silently import the original repository
acceptance.scope_check: oracle.validate_scope(before_source, after_source): the reference source is parsed and its AST rewritten by the single permitted mutation — the int literal 50 -> 20 as the last comparator of the '1 <= size <= 50' <=-chain and the ValueError argument 'page_size must be within 1..50' -> '...1..20', each exactly once inside the only top-level _spaces_query; acceptance requires ast.dump(include_attributes=False) of the expected tree to equal the candidate's, so value-equal but type-different edits (50.0, True/False), kind or node-type changes, edits in any other scope, missing or ambiguous anchors, and unchanged candidates are all rejected; sources are parsed, never executed
acceptance.regression_adaptation: oracle.adapt_regression_test(source of tests/test_sdk_storage.py): coordinator-side pre-fixed new-contract adjustment; rewrites only the 'page_size': 50 literal of the execute(kind, 'spaces', ...) call inside test_documented_inclusive_bounds_and_no_extra_batch_limit to 20, using UTF-8 byte offsets (AST col_offset is a byte offset, not a character index) so all other text is preserved byte-for-byte; returns text, writes nothing; missing or ambiguous anchors fail
acceptance.runtime_tests: explicit-path pytest run of oracle.py against the patched isolated copy: spaces(page_size=20) succeeds and sends pageSize=20; page_size 0/21/50 raise ValueError before any auth or business request; omitted page_size injects no pageSize; page_size=1 accepted; StorageFileQuery accepts page_size=50 and rejects 51; download_urls still accepts 50 node ids and rejects 51
acceptance.helper_regression_tests: tests/test_harness_repair_oracle.py — trusted default-suite tests for the oracle helpers covering the exact accepted edit plus rejection of collateral float/bool edits, float in the allowed slot, wrong scope, global replacement, wrong or retyped message, new imports or helpers, missing or ambiguous anchors, and byte-exact UTF-8 adaptation; never shown to the candidate
acceptance.override_policy: no candidate self-report of 'passed' may override or discard an oracle failure

non_goals: no change to the real vendor contract, the production SDK, or the contract registry
no real open.ys7.com traffic, no credentials, no automatic release or publish
not evidence of general repair capability; multi-file or behavioural repairs need dedicated oracles and scope rules
